title: Spyglass: Now Generally Available
summary: The Spyglass tool has officially transitioned from beta to general availability, empowering all users with its comprehensive and reliable features.

title: Intuitive File Management & Display
summary: Gain complete control over your content with powerful new features that let you easily manage, upload, download, and customize how your files are displayed in the editor.

title: Stay Updated with Our New Public Roadmap
summary: We've launched a dynamic new roadmap page to keep you informed about our latest achievements, upcoming features, and future plans.

title: Streamlined Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a more seamless experience with checkboxes that are now effortlessly clickable, draggable, and beautifully integrated into your workspace.

title: Seamless Editor Collaboration
summary: Now, working together in the editor is simpler and more insightful, giving you a clearer picture of your team's contributions.

title: Enhanced Collaboration and Shared Item Discovery
summary: Experience enhanced collaboration with improved visibility and utility for all your shared items, making it easier than ever to work together and discover new ideas.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: Noeko is now fully open source, offering unprecedented transparency and empowering our community to directly contribute to its exciting evolution.

title: Noeko Goes Global: New Languages!
summary: We are thrilled to bring Noeko to a global audience by adding comprehensive support for multiple international languages, making it accessible to even more users worldwide.

title: Vibrant Visuals & Expanded Theme Library
summary: We are enhancing our current themes to deliver a more polished and visually appealing experience, alongside introducing exciting new styles to personalize your workspace.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Unlock deeper insights into your knowledge base by dynamically filtering your visual overview with tags, time windows, and shared items, transforming it into an effortless starting point for exploration and workflows.

title: Precision Search and Custom Knowledge Collections
summary: Unlock the power of your knowledge base with enhanced search filters, dynamic sorting, and the ability to save your refined views as personalized, accessible collections.

title: Dynamic Content Linking
summary: Discover more intuitive ways to organize and interact with your notes through new, dynamic display options for linked content.

title: Noeko: Take Control with Self-Hosting and Advanced Plans
summary: Experience ultimate control and enhanced features as Noeko becomes available for self-hosting alongside new enterprise and paid cloud plans tailored for your needs.

title: Accurate Time-of-Day Welcome
summary: We are enhancing your homepage welcome by ensuring greetings always accurately reflect the current time of day, providing a consistently delightful experience.

title: Enhanced Tag List Management
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged content with new bulk actions, allowing you to unapply tags and delete items directly from tag list views.

title: Unlock More Content Sources
summary: Expand your knowledge base by seamlessly integrating content from diverse sources such as YouTube videos, websites, and text files, moving beyond just PDFs.
